top.title: MTAP deletion confers enhanced dependency on the PRMT5 arginine methyltransferase in cancer cells.
PRMT1 loss sensitizes cells to PRMT5 inhibition.
Cryo-EM structure-based selection of computed ligand poses enables design of MTA-synergic PRMT5 inhibitors of better potency.
RIOK1 kinase activity is required for cell survival irrespective of MTAP status.
